0022600131.text: The Lakers (3-0, 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West) host the Portland Trail Blazers (2-0, 2nd in the Northwest and 0.5 games back, 4th in the West), with Los Angeles 2-0 at home and riding a three-game win streak. The Lakers are without Adou Thiero (out with knee inflammation; last season he averaged 1.9 points and 6.0 minutes per game) and Cameron Carr (out with an oblique strain), while Portland is without Chris Youngblood (out with ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (out following knee surgery), and Branden Carlson (concussion) and Scoot Henderson (ankle soreness) are day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not played each other this season, and in 2025-26 the Lakers lost the season series 1-2, including a 132-116 defeat in Portland on January 17, 2026.
